class.name: RoadVehicleRenderingServer
class.brief_description: What a road vehicle looks like, drawn.
class.description: A [VehicleRenderingServer] of road vehicles: drawn where [RoadVehicleServer] places them on their road, their wheels ([RoadVehicleAppearance]) turned by the distance run ([method RoadVehicleController.get_wheels_angle_deg]). A plugin's renderer derives from it and stands in its place under the same singleton.
